fullContentHtml:
Indian Bank Specialist Officer SO Result 2026 – Full Details

Indian Bank has released Result for the recruitment of Specialist Officer SO on the official website. This recruitment was released for 350 posts. Applications for the Indian Bank Specialist Officer SO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 April 2026, to 28 April 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Indian Bank Specialist Officer SO Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 April 2026
  • Last Date : 28 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 April 2026
  • Result : 02 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 175/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Indian Bank Specialist Officer SO Result 2026?

Indian Bank Specialist Officer SO Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
